result.title: Certified, Not Explained: Exact Token Erasure in Gated Vision State Space Models
result.summary: Vision models built on Mamba are often explained through their selective step size Delta, on the assumption that a token the scan does not admit cannot influence the prediction. We test that in a concept bottleneck model for lung-nodule malignancy built on a single gated, bidirectional selective state-space block. The answer becomes an interpretability framework: a guarantee, a procedure that checks it, and a pre-registered audit of what it explains. For a fixed gate pattern, masking the input of the causal convolution of the block and giving closed tokens zero weight at readout makes the concept and task logits exactly invariant to the closed tokens. Gating Delta is neither necessary nor sufficient. On LIDC-IDRI, a path-by-path knockout over 15 cross-validated models agrees with this in every run: the largest logit change is exactly 0 whenever the conditions hold and between 4.1 and 6.7 when they do not. The gated model reaches a pooled out-of-fold AUROC of 0.8425 +/- 0.0085, level with an ungated Mamba bottleneck (0.8428). The guarantee belongs to the masked model, not to the gate as an explanation. Post-hoc rankers, which inherit the guarantee on this model, order tokens better than the gate. Gate maps from a model trained on permuted labels are as close to the real maps as two real-label seeds are to each other. Under retraining, the tokens of the gate carry more task information than random tokens and, on shifted crops, more than central ones, but no more than the tokens chosen by hidden attention. We therefore read the gate as a certified support set produced by mask supervision. Splitting the Oracle Impurity Score into own-concept and cross-concept parts reveals differences the aggregate score misses. Partitioning the readout reduced leakage slightly under an earlier recipe, and the final model sits at, rather than below, the level implied by correlations among the true concepts.

AI.brief_summary: 在基于单个门控双向选择性状态空间块、面向肺结节恶性的概念瓶颈模型中，检验「Delta 门控即解释」的假设，给出使输出对闭锁 token 精确不变的掩码条件及核查流程，并在 LIDC-IDRI 上以 15 个交叉验证模型的逐路径 knockout 做预注册审计。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作直接诊断「被门控排除的视觉 token 是否真的不影响预测」，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献归因的可解释性声明是否有精确保证，其「门控只是掩码监督产出的支持集、事后 ranker 排序更好」的结论也值得与 latent 证据选择机制对照。
